brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: A base that holds removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Full hex base piece (0,0,0) with a removable 2-compartment bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2) seated in its cell. Only one bin: a second bin on the adjacent full base at (2,0) and a base at (1,1) both made the cap faces clash with the drawer frame (MESH_CLASH), so I removed them.
drawer:0#1,0#cut (Drawer, south-style) on the cut face of the North-half base at (1,0,0;half-n). check_build clear.
handle:0,0,0;top (Trinity handle insert set, inserts on the top cover) on the full base's top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top.

The configurator checks fit and collisions only. I did not verify weight, balance, or whether the printed PETG parts will carry a loaded organizer; the build is a single connected block with capped faces and locked joints, but it has not been proven portable in use.
Not checked by the configurator; the BOM notes M6 bolts must be hand-tightened to about 2 N.m on printed PETG, and that the clamp relaxes over time.

finish.summary: Built a small organizer: a full base with a removable 2-compartment bin, a half-depth base beside it carrying a drawer, and a top cover with a carry handle. Faces capped and joints locked; check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear. Limitation: only one removable bin fit, because extra bases beside the drawer clashed with its frame. Portability and material strength are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
